newsitem.title: USA: Peru has no immediate Brady buyback plans-official.
newsitem.headline: Peru has no immediate Brady buyback plans-official.

text.p: Peru has no immediate need to buy back its Brady bonds or issue new foreign debt, although the option to do so is always "in the cards," a Peruvian official said on Wednesday.
Roberto Abusada, senior advisor to Peru's minister of finance, told reporters that the government felt no pressure to issue new debt.
"The pressure to go to the market is not there, because we don't have public-sector financing needs," Abusada said.
Peru reported a primary surplus of 830 million soles ($313 million) in the first quarter.
Abusada added that Peru would keep its options open for any possibility to improve its debt profile, saying, "That's always in the cards."
